ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity (off-white/light grey) dominates approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area against low intensity (black/dark grey) edge and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white/grey field across both lobes; dark-intensity linear banding along the entire trailing edge; localized high-contrast dark spots clustered around the central peduncle insertion and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated sharp V-shaped depression at approximately 80 degrees with moderate depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; edge profile is jagged and continuous from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to a tapering distal tip; lobes exhibit a broad convex curvature on the leading edge (partially obscured).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark, circular pixel clusters located at the distal tips (left and right) and a small cluster of dark focal spots near the base of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented pinkish/reddish linear disruptions visible on the lower central portion of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the left lobe trailing edge; dark brownish clusters at distal tips indicative of barnacle colonization.
